biography_summary: 马修·梅（Matthew/Mathew May），澳大利亚籍企业顾问和律师，拥有超过三十年的跨太平洋地区企业法律与战略咨询经验。他毕业于新南威尔士大学法学专业（1978年），曾在国际律师事务所Blake Dawson Waldron（现Ashurst）担任合伙人，长期负责巴布亚新几内亚业务，积累了在巴新法律和商业环境方面的深厚经验。离开律所后，May联合创建了太平洋金融顾问有限公司（Pacific Financial Advisers），专注能源和资源领域的战略咨询。随后创立May International有限公司，为澳大利亚和巴布亚新几内亚的企业提供包括市场进入战略、并购、合资企业、融资结构设计和公司治理等全方位咨询服务。他曾担任南太平洋银行（BSP）的企业与交易顾问，并为巴布亚新几内亚政府提供咨询服务。在国企领域，他曾担任新几内亚航空、PNG Power和PNG Ports等巴新主要国企的战略顾问。2022年5月，被国企部长William Duma任命为库穆尔控股有限公司（KCH）董事会董事，参与管理巴布亚新几内亚所有非石油非矿业国有资产。目前他还担任TKI Limited（奥克泰迪矿业主要承包商土地所有者公司）董事和尼吉尼保险集团有限公司（Niugini Assurance Group Limited）董事长。May常驻悉尼，业务重心横跨澳大利亚和巴布亚新几内亚两国。

collection_meta.notes: Profile of Mathew/Matthew May, Director of Kumul Consolidated Holdings (KCH). Confirmed as an Australian corporate lawyer and adviser based in Sydney. Full name appears as both 'Mathew May' and 'Matthew May' in different sources. KCH appointment confirmed via Post-Courier (May 27, 2022) LinkedIn post and KCH Annual Review 2018/2022. Career details from ASX announcement (Oct 2012) and mayint.com. Education: University of New South Wales law degree (1978) from lawyers.com; St Ignatius College Riverview from LinkedIn. Blake Dawson partnership confirmed via ASX document. Current directorships at TKI Limited and Niugini Assurance Group from mayint.com. Email and phone from mayint.com. Birth date not publicly available. Note: KCH Annual Review lists him as 'Director' while The Official Board also lists him as Director of Kumul Telikom Holdings (a KCH subsidiary).
